name: Dustin Poirier

official.status: Retired after UFC 318 (July 19, 2025); his look is modelled on 2024-2025 fight shape.

face.shape: Long, angular oval: widest at the cheekbones and temples, tapering to a moderately narrow, slightly squared chin. Lean, faintly hollow cheeks.
face.jaw: Defined and angular, medium width; the jaw line is sharp under short stubble.
face.chin: Medium-narrow, slightly squared, moderately projecting, medium height.
face.cheekbones: High and prominent, with flat to slightly hollow cheeks below them.
face.brow_ridge: Prominent and heavy, with thickened scar tissue over both brows from fighting.
face.forehead: High and broad. The hairline recedes at both temples into a mild M with the centre intact.

eyes.shape: Almond, slightly narrow, deep-set under the brow, mildly hooded; outer corners level. Slight bags under the lower lids.
eyes.spacing: Average, about one eye width apart.
eyes.colour: Dark brown. Closest embed iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Fairly straight and low, short tails, the inner ends set slightly lower, which gives a steady, intense look.
eyebrows.colour: Dark brown, darker than the buzz-cut hair reads.

nose.width: Medium bridge, moderately wide at the nostrils.
nose.bridge: Straight in the front view but broad and slightly flattened through the middle (fight wear).
nose.hump: Small bump high on the bridge in the 2024 right-side profile; otherwise straight.
nose.tip: Rounded, fleshy, slightly bulbous, pointing slightly down.
nose.fight_damage: Broadened, flattened bridge; it bled heavily in the 2024 cage photo. No obvious sideways deviation in the front view.

face.mouth: Medium width. Thin upper lip, medium lower lip, corners straight to slightly down; usually a closed, tight-lipped expression.

ears.cauliflower: Yes, heavy on both ears: the upper helix and antihelix are swollen and thickened, and both ears stick out clearly from the head (much more than in his 2011 photos). Together with the tattoos this is his most recognisable feature.

face.notable_marks_scars: Scar tissue and thickening over both eyebrows. A small red tattoo (a letter "K" with a diamond) on the right side of the neck just behind and below the right ear. A smaller dark tattoo sits behind the left ear at the hairline (seen only from behind).

hair.style: Very short buzz cut, slightly longer on top than on the sides, no part. In December 2021 he wore a short side-swept crop (about 3-4 cm on top); the 2023 training still, the studio set, UFC 302 (2024) and UFC 318 (July 2025) all show the buzz cut. The undated weigh-in photo (cap on backwards) shows a few cm of darker hair through the cap opening, so he sometimes grows the top out between fights.
hair.colour: Medium ash-brown. Because the scalp shows through, it reads light brown to tan in photos; the strands themselves are medium brown.
hair.colour_samples_note: Samples mix hair and scalp, so they are lighter and redder than the strands. colour_hex is the estimated strand colour; for a buzz cut, render it as a scalp tint blending skin toward this colour.
hair.hairline: Mild M: receding at both temples, front centre intact; no crown thinning visible.

facial_hair.colour: Dark brown with lighter, slightly greyish hairs on the chin.
facial_hair.colour_samples_note: Sample mixes stubble and skin; strand colour estimated as colour_hex.
facial_hair.density: Medium, even over the jaw, chin, upper lip and lower cheeks.
facial_hair.length_mm: About 2-4 mm (heavy stubble) in the studio headshot and 2025 weigh-in.
facial_hair.shape: Full stubble following the jaw, natural cheek line set low, neckline under the jaw.

tone_samples.spot: left cheek (the near, lit side in this three-quarter view of his left side)

skin.body_note: The studio abdomen sample is darker and more tanned than the face (deep shadows between the abs also pull it down).
skin.undertone: Warm, light-medium, tanned. The face looks a little pinker than the torso.
skin.freckles_marks: No freckles visible; heavy tattoo coverage on both arms, chest and hands. Light brown leg hair.
skin.texture_pick: middleage_caucasian_male tinted warmer and slightly tanned toward tone_hex.

body.build: Lean, athletic, medium frame with long tattooed arms (reach 183 cm at 175 cm); wiry rather than bulky.
body.body_fat_notes: Sharp six-pack and obliques in both studio stance photos and at his final weigh-in (July 2025, described as his leanest).
body.shoulders: Moderately broad, rounded deltoids, moderate traps.
body.arms: Lean and muscular, long, both fully sleeved.
body.legs: Lean, defined thighs and medium calves; light leg hair.
body.posture: Head slightly forward, shoulders relaxed and a little rounded.
body.notable_physique_traits: Full tattoo sleeves on both arms, chest pieces, southpaw stance.

tattoos.where: Right upper chest, under the collarbone
tattoos.description: Script in two lines reading "Parker Noëlle", black, cursive
tattoos.size: About 15 cm wide x 8 cm tall

tattoos.where: Left chest, from the collarbone down over the pec to the nipple
tattoos.description: Black tiger-stripe / claw-mark pattern with three red vertical kanji (武士道, bushido) in the middle

tattoos.where: Right arm, full sleeve from shoulder to wrist
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey Japanese-style sleeve: a samurai/oni-mask face on the upper arm and forearm, wind/cloud shading, red rose and red petal accents at the shoulder, and a script name (starting "Dean...") on the inner forearm

tattoos.where: Left arm, full sleeve from shoulder to wrist
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey Japanese-style sleeve with red-centred flowers (peony or blossom) on the shoulder and upper arm, waves/clouds and figures on the forearm

tattoos.where: Right side of the neck, just behind and below the right ear
tattoos.description: Red letter "K" with a small red diamond (playing-card style)
Black ornamental/script tattoos on the back of the hands and fingers (seen in 2011 and July 2025)

tattoos.where: Right thigh, front/outer side just below the shorts line
tattoos.description: Solid dark tattoo shaped like a cross or fleur-de-lis (upright bar with short side arms), mostly hidden by shorts; seen when his shorts rode up at UFC 318. Low confidence on the exact design.

tattoos.where: Back of the neck just behind the left ear, at the hairline
tattoos.description: Small dark (black/grey) tattoo, roughly diamond-shaped, seen only from behind in the UFC 318 embrace photo; possibly a counterpart to the red "K"-and-diamond on the right side. Low confidence on the design.

accessories_seen: Gold chain and a large gold watch at the 2025 weigh-in, backwards black cap; gold UFC title-fight gloves at UFC 302.

kit.typical_shorts: Black UFC-kit shorts with a grey snakeskin print, white diagonal stripes at the sides, a vertical UFC wordmark on his right thigh and the crypto.com logo (studio; no maker logo visible). Multicolour tropical-floral "Diamond" shorts (red, teal, blue and green flowers and palm leaves on black) at UFC 302 (2024), and a darker red/green floral version at UFC 318 (2025).
kit.gloves: Standard black UFC 4 oz gloves with corner-coloured cuffs (blue cuff at UFC 318); gold gloves in title fights.

morphs_not_in_embed._note: assets/embed/mh-manifest.json has no ear targets. Protruding cauliflower ears are a key likeness cue; use these if standard MakeHuman ear modifiers are added, or fake it with a small ear mesh offset.

render_hints.skin_base: middleage_caucasian_male tinted warmer and tanned toward tone_hex
render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow010 or eyebrow001, tinted #3b2a22, low and straight
render_hints.hair: no hair proxy: buzz cut as a scalp tint (#5c4334 blended over skin), with the receding temples
render_hints.beard: heavy-stubble texture over jaw, chin and upper lip, colour #4a3328
render_hints.tattoos: Full sleeves on both arms and the two chest pieces are essential; a decal or skin overlay is needed for him to read correctly.

notes: Confidence: high for hair, ears, tattoos, build and skin; medium for face proportions; low-to-medium for exact morph values. 11 photos (2 embed-ok: the 2011 CC BY-SA fan-expo photo and the 2011 public-domain Navy photo; 9 reference-only, incl. two Commons YouTube stills whose CC BY claim has not been licence-reviewed and one Commons file with a doubtful own-work claim). Recent coverage is limited: the newest usable face is an undated weigh-in photo published in July 2025 (he retired that month), and there is nothing clean from 2026. The best true profile is the 2024 cage shot (bloody nose); the 2011 Navy photo is a real profile but 15 years old. What to watch: (1) the protruding cauliflower ears matter a lot and the embed has no ear targets. (2) Tattoo sleeves and chest pieces. (3) Buzz cut with receding temples, heavy brow over deep-set dark eyes, broad flattened nose. (4) Lean, not bulky.
